integrity: The all-order proof is a transfer bijection, an exact characteristic determinant, and formal coefficient extraction. Finite brute-force tests are corroboration and do not replace the proof. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: All statements concern labeled ordinary cycle prisms of order n>=3. The ungraded maximal-matching total was published as OEIS A284703 and is not claimed as new; the graded refinement and minimum-layer law are assessed with residual equivalent-priority risk. No independent audit or certification of absolute priority has been performed.
title: Complete maximal-matching polynomial and minimum-size multiplicities of cycle prisms
